entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, I think I need to return my VeloBand. I'm not sure if I'm doing this right, but it's not working.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and email address?
Yes, it's Alex Chen, and the email is a.chen@email.com.

Thank you, Alex. I see your recent order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered five days ago. You mentioned it's not working. To best help you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
I think it's a fault? The pulse rate is... it's just wrong. The whole thing feels like a piece of **garbage**. I'm so confused by all the settings.

I'm sorry to hear that the pulse tracking isn't working as you expected. I can definitely try and help you get that sorted out. We have a few simple troubleshooting steps that usually fix calibration issues.
Oh, I really **don't have time** for that. It's all just too complicated for me. I **just want my money** back, please. Can't you just help me with a **refund**?
I understand you'd prefer to go straight to a return. Let me just pull up our current return policy to confirm the eligibility for you. One moment.

Alright, thank you for your patience, Alex. I've checked the policy, and it states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you received yours just five days ago, you're well within that window.
Oh, really? So you can process it for me? That's such a relief.

Yes, absolutely. I'm processing the return for you now. I've just emailed a prepaid shipping label to you. Please place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. We'll issue the full refund once we receive the item at our warehouse.
Wow, thank you so much, Charlie. I was so worried this would be difficult. I really appreciate your help.
It's my pleasure. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
